title: Exotic Crispy Indian Eggplant Baingan Bharta
description: A crispy and adventurous Indian dish featuring eggplant, almond flour, and spices, deep-fried to perfection. This Tamil-inspired recipe is a twist on the traditional baingan bharta.

ingredients.name: spices
ingredients.notes: including cumin, coriander, and garam masala

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the almond flour, chickpea flour, spices, salt, and pepper.
Add the cubed eggplant to the bowl and toss to coat with the flour mixture.
Deep-fry the eggplant cubes in batches until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Remove the fried eggplant from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat and add the lemon juice and chopped cilantro.
Add the fried eggplant to the pan and toss to coat with the lemon juice and cilantro mixture.
Serve the crispy eggplant hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Traditionally, baingan bharta is served with naan or rice, so feel free to add your favorite sides.
